question_text: As shown in the figure, a rectangular wire loop ABCD is inserted perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field with a constant magnetic field $\mu$. The loop passes through position 1 and finally position 3 with the same velocity $v$. Which of the following statements is not true?

options.option_text: When the loop passes through position 1, a constant e.m.f. is induced across AD and BC.
As the loop passes through position 2, induced e.m.f. will be constant only at position 2.
At position 3, a constant e.m.f. will be induced only across AD and BC.
The directions of the resultant force on the loop due to magnetic field at positions 1 and 3 are opposite to each other.
The directions of the forces due to magnetic field on the loop at positions 1 and 3 are opposite to each other.
